Subject: Procurement readiness & MAP check-in — AcmeCloud

Thanks again for the time this morning, Jordan & team — good conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we all have alignment: 

1) Procurement path options we discussed:
   - PO through AcmeCloud finance (standard corporate PO) — your preferred path
   - Card (one-off) for faster initial pilot
   - Marketplace procurement (Azure/GCP marketplace) — you mentioned this is possible but you'd need procurement + legal sign-off to rely on marketplace billing

2) Typical internal review flow (what we expect on your side):
   - Legal review (T&Cs) → Security (SOC 2 questionnaire + evidence) → Finance (budget approval) → PO issuance
   - Estimated durations you mentioned: legal ~1–2 weeks, security review ~1 week (upon receiving SOC2 artifacts), finance/PO ~1–2 weeks after approvals

3) Mutual Action Plan (attached): milestone owners and dates. Action items for AcmeCloud:
   - Confirm whether PO or card for pilot (Jordan / Procurement) — target: 2026-03-25
   - Share procurement contact for final PO issuance (Procurement team)
   - Any mandatory contract clauses or procurement form we should slot into the SOW (Legal)

Action items for Redwood:
   - Provide SOC2 summary and security contact (Marcus) — attached
   - Send pricing summary and PO instructions (see attached spreadsheet) — attached
   - Draft SOW/Order Form for pilot to accelerate legal review

Next checkpoint: propose Wed 3/24 at 10am PT for a short MAP check-in — 20 minutes to confirm procurement path and owners. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: 20260316-AcmeCloud-MAP-v2.pdf (MAP), soc2_summary_2025.pdf, redwood-pricing-summary.xlsx

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Hill <jordan.hill@acmecloud.com>

Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & MAP check-in — AcmeCloud

Thanks Marissa — great recap. A few notes from procurement/legal side: 

- Procurement preference: PO for pilots that go beyond $25k but we can do a corporate card for a small pilot (<= $5k). We need to see the final pricing + billing cadence to confirm.
- Marketplace: we'd prefer to use the marketplace for production later, but for pilot we usually do PO/off-contract to avoid the marketplace onboarding delay.
- Timing: Legal wants to see the SOW + any contract amendments. Typical legal review is ~1–2 weeks depending on redlines. Security will need the SOC2 summary and a short questionnaire — can your security team fill out our standard security questionnaire (I'll attach separately if helpful).

Owners:
- Procurement lead: Samantha Lee (samantha.lee@acmecloud.com)
- Legal: Jordan Hill (myself)
- Finance: Mike Turner (finance@acmecloud.com) — will be involved when we have final pricing/PO amount

We can commit to a MAP check-in on 2026-03-24 10:00 PT. Please send the invite. Also please send the SOW and the one-page pricing summary ASAP so finance can start reviewing budget.

Regards,
Jordan Hill
Head of Procurement | AcmeCloud
